female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

institutional-partner-faster.title: Borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster regardless of gender.
institutional-partner-faster.body: Pitches that mention specific institutional partners or field partners are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

family-responsibilities-slower-general.title: Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
family-responsibilities-slower-general.body: Pitches that reference household duties or the need to support family members are associated with slower funding speeds for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

male-training-administrative-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention training in saving, resource mobilization, and record-keeping may fund more slowly.

female-effort-descriptors-faster.body: Female borrowers who use strong descriptors for their own effort and determination may fund faster.

female-external-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention external business challenges like unpredictable weather or rising costs may fund faster.

female-asset-acquisition-slower.body: Female borrowers who focus on asset acquisition as their primary loan goal may fund more slowly.

female-food-business-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention running a business selling food may fund faster.

male-geographic-location-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention specific geographic locations may fund faster.

female-social-contributions-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention social contributions to their community may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders or partner organizations may fund more slowly.

female-inventory-listing-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide detailed lists of specific supplies or inventory items may fund more slowly.

female-kampala-sourcing-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention sourcing products directly from Kampala may fund faster.

female-family-responsibilities-slower.title: Pitches from women that reference family responsibilities or household duties are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-family-responsibilities-slower.retrospective: Generalized to both genders based on new male observations

female-specific-quantities-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific quantities or a wide variety of products may fund faster.
female-specific-quantities-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that inventory listing was in slower female pitches

female-precise-child-ages-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific ages for their children rather than age ranges may fund faster.

inventory-listing-interaction.title: Listing specific inventory items may accelerate funding for men but decelerate it for women.
inventory-listing-interaction.retrospective: Contradicted by female observations showing inventory listing correlates with faster funding

female-transportation-costs-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the increase in cost of transportation may fund faster.
female-transportation-costs-faster.retrospective: Dropped stale puzzle to maintain cap

female-husband-occupation-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their husband's occupation may fund faster.
female-husband-occupation-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observation

female-refugee-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their refugee status may fund faster.
female-refugee-status-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observation

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to Kiva or their partner organization may fund more slowly.

female-inventory-listing-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific inventory items may fund faster.
female-inventory-listing-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that detailed lists of supplies correlate with slower funding

female-aspirational-goals-faster.title: Pitches from women that mention improving the future of their family or the education of their children are associated with increased funding speed.
female-aspirational-goals-faster.retrospective: Retired in favor of a broader claim about aspirational language
